description: Datadog observability platform with an HTTP REST API for dashboards, monitors, logs, metrics and more.
auth_notes: API key sent in DD-API-KEY header; some endpoints also need an Application key in DD-APPLICATION-KEY. OAuth2 (authorization code with PKCE) is supported for confidential clients.
gate_detail: Sources describe the key headers and OAuth client flow but never say how a developer obtains keys, whether a free signup or paid plan is needed, or any sandbox. Access prerequisites are not established.
api_scope: Resource-oriented REST API returning JSON across many areas (dashboards, monitors, logs, metrics, incidents, users); official client libraries in Java, Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript and Rust.
mcp_notes: Datadog MCP Server documented on docs.datadoghq.com; URL given only as a template, https://mcp.<YOUR_DATADOG_SITE>/v1/mcp.
blocker_detail: Sources do not state how credentials are obtained or any plan requirement, so access cannot be confirmed.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header DD-API-KEY
For some endpoints, you also need an Application key , which uses the header DD-APPLICATION-KEY .
The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.
Connect AI agents to Datadog observability data using the MCP Server to query metrics, logs, traces, and other insights.

uncertainties: How API and Application keys are obtained is not stated.
Whether a free plan or trial suffices is not stated.
Webhook and sandbox support not established.
MCP URL is a template, not a concrete endpoint.
